Package com.splendor.model.validator

Class MoveValidator

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.model.validator.MoveValidator
public class MoveValidator extends Object
Validates player moves to ensure they comply with game rules. Provides centralized validation logic for all move types.

    • validateTakeTwo

      public ValidationResult validateTakeTwo(Gem gem, Board board)
      Validates the specific "take 2 of the same gem" rule and returns a human-readable ValidationResult rather than throwing an exception. Used to display a friendly explanation to the player before their move is submitted.
      Parameters:
      gem - The gem colour the player wants to take two of.
      board - The current game board.
      Returns:
      A passing ValidationResult if the take-two is legal; a failing one with a rule-violation explanation otherwise.

    • getRuleExplanation

      public ValidationResult getRuleExplanation(Move move, Player player, Game game)
      Returns a ValidationResult with a plain-language explanation of why a move is or is not permitted, without throwing an exception. Unlike validateMove(), this method is specifically designed for display: the message it returns is shown directly to the human player so they understand the rule they would violate. It currently checks the two most common confusion points (take-two bank requirement and buy-card affordability); other move types fall through to an implicit ok() result.
      Parameters:
      move - The move the player intends to make.
      player - The player attempting the move.
      game - The current game state.
      Returns:
      A ValidationResult whose message is suitable for display to the player.
